曾有三载风雨覆山河，曾有万古暗影吞星火。
他们以少年青涩之躯，扛神域倾覆之痛，担天地寂灭之危。于人间学园藏锋芒，于乱世绝境守初心，于孤身蛰伏中熬尽寒凉，于生死鏖战里相拥羁绊。
从冰川封心的孤寂隐忍，从执念缠身的自我困顿，从王族离散的岁岁牵挂，从明暗博弈的步步惊心；六位天启守护者踏过血泊、跨过别离、熬过绝境、渡过往昔，亲手碾碎覆世暗影，亲手抚平天地疮痍，亲手守得人间月明、山河归序。
这一路，有孤军奋战的滚烫倔强，有双向奔赴的温柔赤诚，有跨越三载的久别重逢，有生死与共的岁岁相守。
硝烟落幕，浩劫归零，表层黑暗尽数消散，人间重回烟火寻常。课堂朗朗、晚风温柔、朝夕相伴、岁岁安然，是他们拼尽所有换来的最珍贵圆满。
光明从不是凭空降临，而是有人以身燃星，以心守序，以羁绊为盾，以初心为刃，于无尽黑暗里劈开万丈天光。
第一季的故事，止于风平浪静，止于岁月温柔，止于久别重逢，止于来日方长。
平静烟火之下，暗流依旧蛰伏；盛世安宁之下，终极阴谋未曾消解。幽魇教廷的棋局未落，经年血海深仇未清算，尘封的远古秘辛、潜藏的人间内奸、跨越数年的终极战局，皆在时光深处静静蛰伏。
少年的征途暂歇于盛夏，守护者的宿命奔赴永不终结。
待韶华落幕，待山海重逢，待年少青涩褪去，他们将再度并肩而立，卸去日常温柔，重执天启荣光，奔赴那场蓄势待发的终极终局。
山河不负坚守，光明不负奔赴，羁绊岁岁绵长，初心永不褪色。
愿此间少年，眼底永远有星河，心中永远有赤诚；
愿所有隐忍皆有回甘，所有奔赴皆有归途，所有重逢皆有圆满。

The latest chapter of Star Crown Apocalypse: The Awakening of the Guardians_Conclusion page 1_The Star Crown Apocalypse: The Awakening of the Guardians Lu Xingwan ShikaSeiban_Hot Novel Network
There were three years of wind and rain that covered the mountains and rivers, and there were eternal shadows that swallowed sparks.
With their youthful bodies, they bear the pain of the overthrow of the divine realm and the danger of the destruction of heaven and earth. Hide your edge in the human academy, keep your original intention in troubled times and desperate situations, endure the cold and coldness in solitary dormancy, and embrace each other in the fierce battle of life and death.
From the loneliness and forbearance of the ice-sealed heart, from the self-entrapment entangled with obsessions, from the worries of the royal family for many years, from the heart-breaking game of light and darkness; the six guardians of the apocalypse stepped through the blood, crossed the separation, survived the desperate situation, and passed the past.
Along the way, there is the burning stubbornness of fighting alone, the tenderness and sincerity of running in both directions, the reunion after a long absence that spans three decades, and the years of staying together through life and death.
The smoke of gunpowder has ended, the catastrophe has returned to zero, all the superficial darkness has dissipated, and the world has returned to its normal state of fireworks. The bright classroom, the gentle evening breeze, the companionship day and night, and the peace year after year are the most precious perfections that they have worked hard to obtain.
Light never comes out of thin air, but there are people who use their bodies to burn stars, their hearts to be orderly, their bonds as their shields, their original intentions as their blades, and they split the sky into the endless darkness.
The story of the first season ends with the calmness of the sea, the gentleness of the years, the reunion after a long separation, and the long future.
Under the calm fireworks, the undercurrent is still dormant; under the tranquility of the prosperous age, the ultimate conspiracy has not been resolved. The chess game of the Nightmare Holy See has not yet been settled, and the blood feud has not been settled for many years. The dust-covered ancient secrets, the hidden traitors in the world, and the ultimate battle that spanned several years are all quietly dormant in the depths of time.
The young man's journey pauses in midsummer, while the guardian's destiny continues forever.
When time comes to an end, when mountains and seas meet again, when youth and youth fade away, they will stand side by side again, putting aside their daily tenderness, clinging to the glory of the apocalypse again, and rushing towards the ultimate ending that is ready to go.
The mountains and rivers are worthy of perseverance, the light is worthy of the pursuit, the bond lasts for many years, and the original intention will never fade.
May the young man here always have stars in his eyes and sincerity in his heart;
I hope that all the forbearance will be rewarded, all the efforts will have a return, and all reunions will be successful.
